tasks.design: Configure a native checked export/join in {SPREADSHEET} from actual {ERP} cost records and engineering design classifications, followed by a reusable statistical comparison layout. The technician chooses comparable groups, verifies the joined data and interprets/writes/checks all findings before the separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring studies can repeat cost-table joins and statistical layout setup before actual analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native query joins and statistical worksheet layouts can reuse explicit identifiers and formulas.
tasks.still_hard: Different volumes, processes, allocations and design maturity can confound the comparison.
tasks.human_edge: Avoid attributing a cost difference to sustainability when the designs are not comparable.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated data assembly around actual cost studies.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 with finance and engineering cost-data owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed cost-record joins and statistical worksheet layouts can reduce repeated assembly while comparability and statistical interpretation require human judgment.

assumptions: Finance supplies actual cost exports with period, design/product ID, cost type, amount, currency and volume where needed; engineering supplies actual design classifications. Selection and reconciliation are counted in s2, and rejected rows/source checks in s4. No free clean comparison dataset is assumed.
Unsupported units, duplicate keys or missing cost scope stop for manual reconciliation. No model labels sustainability, fabricates costs or infers causality.

The s4 reduction is repeated statistical-layout setup, not existing calculation runtime, source verification or interpretation. Check native queries/layouts first; equivalent existing configuration removes corresponding gains.
Shares 20/15/20/25/19/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 20 + 5 = 25; 3 hours of mappings/layout upkeep leaves 22 net. Negligible same-system save remains fully retained.
The study record is the actual study output, not an extra status report. Final writing/checking in s5 is ordinary work; edits invalidate the save gate.
unknowns: Actual cost-export consistency and existing native query/layout reuse
research_questions: Measure repeated table assembly separately from source reconciliation and comparison validity.

incremental.description: Maintain cost/design mappings and verify statistical layouts when source definitions change.

tasks.design: Reuse checked standard elements and drawing conventions in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the mechanical CAD application, when preparing actual component fabrication details. The technician devises the component, checks the final method and physical readiness, fabricates/assembles it and inspects the real result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated standard CAD elements can add handling around component development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native standard-part and drawing libraries can reuse fixed geometry and conventions.
tasks.still_hard: Actual design suitability, fabrication, assembly fit and rework remain hands-on work.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the component when real material or interface conditions differ from the drawing.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated standard drawing elements around actual component work.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-2 with the engineering library and fabrication owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native CAD libraries can reuse fixed component elements while actual component design, fabrication and fit inspection remain human work.

assumptions: Actual engineering requirements and existing checked part geometry are available; the technician produces the concept in s1 and captures all real dimensions/method details in s2. No free completed component model is assumed.
Reuse only applicable standard elements; unknown dimensions or unsuitable interfaces require manual design. Existing equivalent libraries remove the gain.

This task produces an actual component and working fabrication details, not a newly invented fabrication report or system release. No hidden machine code deployment, drawing issue or external send is proposed.
Shares 25/20/15/30/10 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 20 times 0.15 = 3; 1 hour of library upkeep leaves 2 net. All physical work remains.
The final fabrication method and physical readiness exist before s3 checks them. Changes return to s3 before fabrication; inspection in s5 does not replace pre-work readiness.
unknowns: Actual repeated standard component elements and existing CAD reuse
research_questions: Measure repeated standard drawing preparation separately from fabrication and custom design.

tasks.design: Configure native change-reference views and checked drafting-style reuse in {OPS_SYSTEM}, engineering change control and CAD. The technician discusses actual changes with staff, resolves correction scope and enters/checks real working-design corrections before the separate save; agreement is never inferred from comments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and drafting conventions add handling around actual correction coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: Native change references and CAD style profiles can reuse existing context and fixed conventions.
tasks.still_hard: Design intent, manufacturability and disagreements require actual staff judgment and coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a correction that fixes one drawing but breaks manufacture or assembly.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated handling around agreed design corrections.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 with engineering change control and affected staff

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native change-reference views and drafting-style reuse can reduce correction handling while staff agreement and design verification remain human work.

assumptions: This is an actual coordination episode with technician-owned working-design corrections. Corrections assigned to other staff are not credited as technician savings and are not silently executed.

Staff produce actual comments and agreement; engineering owns the real requirements/authority. The technician checks sources in s1, obtains agreement in s2, reconciles scope in s3 and captures/checks actual changes in s4.
Native reference/style configuration first. Missing revisions, disputed changes or unsupported authority require manual resolution; no new structured correction feed or inferred approval is assumed.

Shares 15/40/10/34/1 are unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 4.5 + 6.8 = 11.3; 2 hours of native reference/style upkeep leaves 9.3 net. Existing equivalent configuration removes the gain; negligible save is fully retained.
No extra meeting minutes, notifications or production release is invented. Final corrected-design checking is ordinary revision work; changes invalidate the gate.
unknowns: Actual correction ownership and existing native change/style reuse
research_questions: Measure repeated drawing/reference handling separately from discussion and actual engineering corrections.
